purpose: Validate the selected color-rule version on new parent images before accepted-color cache/caption TEST
selection_scope: TRAIN and separately preregistered dev only; historical V2 color-check cannot become fresh check
heldout_membership: Must be preregistered before mask inference, disjoint parents and known pixel identity groups from engineering/dev images
review_sample: Fixed hash within predeclared class/color/achromatic strata; keep inclusion probabilities and every rejection/missing instance
prediction_reveal: After independent annotation is committed, compare frozen candidate labels; do not edit extractor in the check
disagreements: Preserve individual annotations and adjudication; do not coerce agreement
intervals: Image-cluster bootstrap; report sample counts/class support. Wilson is descriptive when one independent instance per image, not a substitute for clustered dependence
report: joint correct binding and color precision
class_release_scope: Only adequately reviewed classes; overall precision does not certify all150 classes
gate_failure: No colored TEST, no automatic retuning on heldout; keep unknown/no-color fallback. Any future repair gets new scientific version and independent check
